title: Cross-language scripting
key_points: Godot allows mixing and matching scripting languages in a single project.
A project can define nodes written in both C# and GDScript.
Instantiating nodes directly from code is possible.
Accessing fields, calling methods, and connecting signals between different language nodes are supported.
limitations: GDScript files cannot inherit from a C# script and vice versa due to complexity and the limitation's unlikely change in the future.
asserts: This source asserts that Godot engine supports cross-language scripting allowing GDScript and C# to coexist within a single project.
scope: The scope of this assertion is the Godot game engine, specifically its scripting capabilities with mixed language nodes within a project.
